description: Read one Steam game's record from steamcozy.com by its id from search/find_games (a Steam app id) or its slug. Returns Markdown with review score and count, price with the lowest since tracking began (2026-07), community tags, what reviewers agree on (praise and criticism with counts), achievement completion, latest official announcements, similar games and links — each with its as-of date. Adult-only titles are not available.

id.description: Steam app id (e.g. '1245620') or steamcozy slug (e.g. 'elden-ring').

name: fetch
title: Read a game's SteamCozy record
